```yaml
name: OpenData Commitment Eligibility

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '**/*.ps1'
      - '**/*.psm1'
      - '**/*.psd1'
      - '**/opendata-commitment-eligibility.yml'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: PowerShell/Setup-PowerShell@v1
        
      - name: Install PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: |
          Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser
          
      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: |
          $errors = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Severity Error
          if ($errors) {
            Write-Error "PSScriptAnalyzer found errors:"
            $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Error $_.Message }
            exit 1
          }

  unit-tests:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: PowerShell/Setup-PowerShell@v1
        
      - name: Install required modules
        run: |
          Install-Module -Name Pester -Force -Scope CurrentUser
          Install-Module -Name Az.Accounts -Force -Scope CurrentUser
          
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          Invoke-Pester -Path . -OutputFormat NUnitXml -OutputFile TestResults.xml -PassThru
          
      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: TestResults.xml

  validate-deployment:
    needs: [lint, unit-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Validate PowerShell files
        run: |
          # Check for basic PowerShell syntax
          find . -name "*.ps1" -o -name "*.psm1" -o -name "*.psd1" | while read file; do
            if ! powershell -Command "Import-Module '$file' -ErrorAction Stop"; then
              echo "Failed to import $file"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          
      - name: Verify recommendations module structure
        run: |
          # Verify required files exist for recommendations app
          if [ ! -f "Recommendations/Recommendations.psm1" ]; then
            echo "Recommendations module not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ ! -f "Recommendations/Recommendations.psd1" ]; then
            echo "Recommendations module manifest not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Count custom recommendation queries
          query_count=$(find . -name "*.ps1" -path "*/Recommendations/*" | wc -l)
          if [ "$query_count" -lt 15 ]; then
            echo "Insufficient recommendation queries found: $query_count"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All validation checks passed"

  documentation-check:
    needs: validate-deployment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Check documentation files
        run: |
          # Verify documentation exists
          if [ ! -f "docs/recommendations-feature.md" ]; then
            echo "Recommendations feature documentation missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ ! -f "docs/best-practices.md" ]; then
            echo "Best practices documentation missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify parameter documentation
          if ! grep -r "noisy recommendations" docs/; then
            echo "Noisy recommendations parameter documentation missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if ! grep -r "force lowercase" docs/; then
            echo "Force lowercase parameter documentation missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Documentation validation passed"

  all-checks-pass:
    needs: [lint, unit-tests, validate-deployment, documentation-check]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Check if all previous jobs passed
        run: |
          echo "All checks completed successfully"
```
